title: How the Fossil Fuel Industry ‘Captured’ Australia and Maintains Its Political Dominance
author: Christopher Wright
text:
As public concern over worsening climate change grows, Australia’s fossil fuel industry has been asserting that coal and gas are central to technological innovation and economic security.
Credit: Takver, Australia/CC by 2.0
Australia is one of the world’s largest exporters of coal and gas and has among the world’s highest per capita carbon emissions. As a leading “petrostate,” it is perhaps unsurprising that the fossil fuel sector has been central in shaping the nation’s energy and climate policies.The political capture of Australia by the fossil fuel industries has stymied any meaningful attempt to move away from fossil energy. They have historically obstructed attempts to regulate and reduce carbon emissions through lobbying, networking, and financial donations to parties in the political arena. The end game is to promote fossil energy to the public as essential to the past, present, and future of Australian society; what can be termed a form of “carbon populism.” [...]
